q: By February 28, 2027, the U.S. government formally announces the lifting or phased easing of its naval blockade of Iran
basis: Lifting the blockade is one of the terms that would go into the first phase of a U.S.-Iran agreement. The estimate is set in line with the forecasts of a ceasefire and reopening of the strait by year's end (15 percent) and of a phased agreement signed by the end of March (25 percent). This forecast tests whether Washington moves from staying the course to a phased agreement.
rs: Announcements by the White House, the Pentagon and U.S. Central Command
